sample / implementation plan

Make release proof follow one candidate

A contained change to candidate ownership, validation receipts, and rollback—without replacing the existing build system.

Implementation contract

One command creates a candidate. Every verification stage accepts that candidate by reference. Publication cannot rebuild it.

Scope boundary. Preserve build commands, credential handling, and remote publication behavior; change only candidate identity and handoff.

Intended operator view

Ownership map

  • src/release/candidate.ts
    Change. Return an immutable candidate reference instead of a transient build directory.
  • src/release/verify.ts
    Change. Accept the reference and emit a structured gate receipt.
  • src/release/publish.ts
    Change. Reject unverified candidates and record the remote receipt.

Four contained phases

  1. 1
    Define identity

    Candidate path, checksum, and build metadata.

  2. 2
    Move gates

    Run existing checks against the reference.

  3. 3
    Bind publish

    Require a verified receipt.

  4. 4
    Exercise handoff

    Use one non-production upload.

The core code boundary

release.ts
42-publish(await build());
42+publish(await verify(candidate));

Publication loses build authority. It can only consume the candidate returned by verification.

Proof and rollback

GateProvesFailure response
Focused unit contractEach stage preserves candidate identityStop before credentials
Archive inspectionExpected payload and checksumDiscard candidate
Non-production uploadExternal handoff accepts the receiptKeep old publisher entrypoint

Execution decision

Implement the candidate reference first, then move existing gates one at a time. Keep the current publisher callable until the non-production handoff succeeds; remove it in the same change that records the first complete receipt.
